authenticated_subject_source.authority: synthetic local identity fixture; not a real service credential

authority_query.unavailable_action: retain unknown and reservation; do not infer failure or submit a new billable operation

idempotency_scope_and_window.authority: synthetic operation ledger; payload conflicts reject instead of reusing a receipt

current_authorization_and_fence_acceptan.permission_source: synthetic policy snapshot version referenced by the operation ledger
current_authorization_and_fence_acceptan.atomic_acceptance_point: compare epoch and authorization inside the transaction recording accepted operation_key
current_authorization_and_fence_acceptan.denial_action: reject without starting a side effect or releasing an unknown reservation

logical_task_attempt_epoch_mapping.stale_result_action: append as stale evidence; never overwrite current accepted state

budget_bound_and_usage_source.reservation_authority: synthetic ledger reserve transaction before submission
budget_bound_and_usage_source.usage_authority: authority query receipt associated with operation_key
budget_bound_and_usage_source.unknown_result_action: keep reservation until authority confirms terminal result or reconciled usage

cancellation_and_unknown_result_contract.unknown_action: retain unknown; cancellation acknowledgement is not terminal and does not prove refund
cancellation_and_unknown_result_contract.retry_condition: only query is repeatable while unknown; resubmission requires same idempotency key and authoritative acceptance policy
